verdicts.verification_notes: Independently verified by source inspection and executing test-2d-engine.mjs: writeOnPage, callout, brace, table, and chart do not exist in clicky-draw-pieces.js or the sandboxed ctx; openPage(url) opens a browser URL rather than an ink page.
Confirmed: brain.ts:94 documents spot, whereas clicky-draw-pieces.js:61-74 only defines point(target, opts). Calling spot() throws ReferenceError: spot is not defined.

Critical/High verification: brain.ts:85 instructs the LLM to pass around: { count: 10, axis: "x"|"y"|"z", at: [0,0,0] }, whereas expandFigurePart() in clicky-draw-engine.js:720 reads const center = v3(around.center, [0, 0, 0]) and completely ignores around.at, collapsing off-origin radial arrays to [0,0,0].

Confirmed: FIGURE_MATERIALS at clicky-draw-engine.js:561-562 defines 'iron' and 'black', not 'cast' or 'carbon' as taught in brain.ts:88. readPartAppearance() falls back to mat: 'gloss', tint: 'cast'|'carbon', which resolves to white.

Critical/High verification: SystemComposition.cs:165,180 calls Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR directly on BeginDraw/EndDraw/Present/Commit, and neither SystemComposition, ScreenPainter, nor StageSwapChain handles DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED (0x887A0005), DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_RESET (0x887A0007), D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET (0x8899000C), or CanvasDevice.DeviceLost.
Confirmed: OverlayWindow caches scale once at creation via GetDpiForWindow(hwnd), does not refresh scale in MoveTo(), and WndProc ignores WM_DPICHANGED (0x02E0).
Confirmed: ShowInScreenRecordings setter invokes _ = ApplyCapturePolicyToAllAsync() fire-and-forget via DrawingThread.RunAsync without awaiting completion.
Confirmed: Mp4VideoWriter constructor does not validate even width/height for NV12/H.264 and computes width * height * 6 in 32-bit signed int before widening to long.

Confirmed by source inspection and test-3d-engine.mjs execution: SHAPES.cone(o) only reads o.r and o.h and calls ConeGeometry(r, h, 36, 16), ignoring o.top (byte-identical 5220 floats / 3456 indices with or without top).

Confirmed: ThreeStage.Dispose() queues a ThreadPool work item that runs if (!running.Join(5000)) { Log.Warn(...); } followed unconditionally by Release(), which disposes d2dTarget, d2dContext, backBufferView, backBuffer, renderer, and wake while frameThread may still be rendering.

Confirmed with precision note: ClickyThreeKernel.failed (HashSet<string> at line 30) is unbounded and never cleared in ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers(), and loadFailed = true (line 311) permanently disables 3D kernel loading. Precision correction: shapes is bounded by byte budget CacheByteBudget = 50331648L (48 MB, line 18/226), not a 256-entry count cap.
Confirmed: Pipelines.EnsureBuilt() sets buildFailed = true permanently with no reset path, and GpuDevice.Shared caches a single static Device without device-removed recreation.

Confirmed: BuildReferralPage() at lines 6142-6172 constructs a 7-element FrameworkElement[] array and never includes FriendCodeGroup() (defined at line 6940), making FriendCodeGroup() and UseFriendCode() dead code.

Critical/High verification: Pressable inherits from Grid (line 18) and only hooks PointerEntered, PointerExited, PointerPressed, PointerReleased, and PointerCaptureLost (lines 181-185). It never sets IsTabStop = true or UseSystemFocusVisuals = true and has no KeyDown handler for Enter/Space, breaking keyboard accessibility across custom UI controls.

Confirmed with precision note: DeveloperFlags.FullAgentActivity getter at line 19 unconditionally returns false while the setter writes to developer-flags.json, making DeveloperFlags.Read(string key) at lines 31-42 unreachable dead code. Also confirmed SettingsContent.cs:8771 gates the Developer page on host.ShowsDeveloperSection. Precision note: SettingsContent.cs:4195-4203 is ProactiveDeveloperGroups() and 'Show agent names', not a FullAgentActivity toggle.

Confirmed: BugReport.Run() opens Gmail compose to hi@heyclicky.com (line 75) and spawns Task.Run(() => SendToSentry(...)) (line 72/91) which packages up to 3 MB of recent logs plus state-<id>.json and calls SentrySdk.CaptureEvent.

new_findings.title: In-Process ClearScript V8 NativeEngine Runs LLM-Generated JavaScript Synchronously on DrawingThread Without the Web Worker Sandbox or Any Execution Timeout / Interrupt() Watchdog
new_findings.description: In browser mode, clicky-draw-engine.js:1149-1187 executes untrusted LLM-generated drawing code inside a Web Worker (WorkerRunner) with a 1500 ms watchdog timer (setTimeout(() => w.terminate(), limit)) to terminate infinite loops. However, in the native desktop app, NativeEngine.cs:145-174 loads clicky-draw-native.js + clicky-draw-engine.js directly inside an in-process ClearScript V8ScriptEngine on the single STA DrawingThread and invokes engine functions synchronously via value.Invoke(asConstructor: false, arguments) (line 284) with no watchdog timer calling V8ScriptEngine.Interrupt() and no V8RuntimeConstraints heap limit. Any LLM-generated drawing script or tick() callback that enters an infinite or long loop permanently freezes DrawingThread, locking up all 2D/3D screen overlays, captions, and cursor animations for the lifetime of the process.
new_findings.reproduction:
1. Inspect src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing/HeyClicky.Drawing.Engine/NativeEngine.cs lines 145-174 and 280-291.
2. Compare with WorkerRunner in src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing/Assets/Engine/clicky-draw-engine.js lines 1149-1187.
3. Observe that NativeEngine invokes __nativeRun / __nativeFrame synchronously on DrawingThread with no Timer/CancellationToken calling engine.Interrupt().
new_findings.expected: NativeEngine should configure V8RuntimeConstraints (max heap size) and arm a background timer (e.g., 1500 ms for initial run, 100 ms per tick) that calls engine.Interrupt() if LLM-generated JavaScript exceeds the execution budget.
new_findings.observed: Zero calls to engine.Interrupt() or V8RuntimeConstraints exist anywhere in NativeEngine.cs; an infinite while(true){} loop in an LLM drawing script permanently hangs DrawingThread.
new_findings.remediation: Arm a lightweight System.Threading.Timer around NativeEngine.Invoke calls that invokes engine.Interrupt() after 1500 ms (initial script execution) or 100 ms (per-frame tick), catch ScriptInterruptedException, and reset the scene.

new_findings.title: ClickyThreeKernel Thread-Safety Race on V8ScriptEngine Disposal, Missing V8 Heap/Execution Constraints, and Unconditional Disposal of Active Stage GPU Buffers on Idle Timeout
new_findings.description: ClickyThreeKernel has three compounding lifecycle defects: (1) Lock asymmetry on engine and loadFailed: WarmUp() (lines 98-105) reads engine and loadFailed under lock (gate), and HeapBytes (line 73) calls engine?.GetRuntimeHeapInfo().TotalHeapSize without any lock, while Run() (lines 181-186) disposes engine and sets engine = null and LoadIfNeeded() (lines 290-311) assigns engine and loadFailed on the worker thread without acquiring lock (gate). Calling HeapBytes while Run() disposes engine can throw ObjectDisposedException or access a torn reference. (2) Unbounded V8 execution: LoadIfNeeded() (line 290) creates V8ScriptEngine without V8RuntimeConstraints or an Interrupt() timeout around buildFunction.Invoke(false, kind, recipe) (line 349). (3) Premature GPU buffer disposal while stages are still live: When work.TryTake times out after IdleRelease (5 minutes without new shape builds), ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers() (lines 244-274) unconditionally disposes item.Gpu (ID3D11Buffer vertex/index buffers) and sets item.Gpu = null on every cached Mesh3D before checking if (ThreeStage.LiveCounts.Stages == 0) at line 269, racing with any open ThreeStage render thread reading mesh.Gpu.
new_findings.reproduction:
1. Inspect src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing3D/HeyClicky.Drawing3D/ClickyThreeKernel.cs lines 67-79, 96-106, 179-189, 244-274, and 290-349.
2. Observe that ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers() disposes item.Gpu on lines 255-267 before checking ThreeStage.LiveCounts.Stages == 0 on line 269.
new_findings.expected: All reads/writes/disposals of engine and loadFailed should be synchronized or marshaled onto the kernel thread; ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers() should skip disposing GPU buffers (or acquire GpuDevice.Shared.ContextLock) while ThreeStage.LiveCounts.Stages > 0.
new_findings.observed: engine is mutated/disposed outside lock (gate), HeapBytes reads engine lock-free, and ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers() disposes Mesh3D.Gpu even when active ThreeStage instances are rendering those meshes.
new_findings.remediation: Check if (ThreeStage.LiveCounts.Stages > 0) return; at the top of ReleaseCachedGpuBuffers(), synchronize Mesh3D.Gpu disposal under GpuDevice.Shared.ContextLock, and guard engine lifecycle transitions under lock (gate).

new_findings.title: PhotoLoader.IsPublic IPv6 SSRF Filter Bypass (Missing NAT64 64:ff9b::/96, 6to4 2002::/16, Teredo 2001::/32, and ::ffff:0:0/96) and Unreachable Decompiler Artifact
new_findings.description: PhotoLoader.FetchByHttpAsync resolves DNS hostnames and filters each IP through PhotoLoader.IsPublic(IPAddress) (lines 557-589) to prevent LLM-generated photo() calls from fetching internal/loopback resources. While IsPublic handles IPv4 private/loopback ranges and IPv6 loopback/link-local/site-local/ULA (fc00::/7) and IsIPv4MappedToIPv6, it does not block IPv6unspecified (::), IPv6 documentation/benchmarking ranges (2001:db8::/32), or IPv6 transition prefixes that embed loopback/private IPv4 addresses (NAT64 64:ff9b::/96, 6to4 2002::/16, Teredo 2001:0000::/32). Additionally, lines 524-526 contain unreachable decompiler artifact code (IL_042f: byte[] result3; return result3;) that triggers CS0162/CS0164 when warnings are unmasked.
new_findings.reproduction:
1. Inspect src/desktop/Kursor.Drawing/HeyClicky.Drawing.Media/PhotoLoader.cs lines 524-526 and 557-589.
2. Trace IsPublic(IPAddress.Parse("64:ff9b::127.0.0.1")) or IsPublic(IPAddress.IPv6Any): bytes[0] is 0x00 or 0x64, none of the IPv6 checks match, and IsPublic returns true.
new_findings.expected: IsPublic should reject IPAddress.IPv6Any (::), multicast (ff00::/8), NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96), 6to4 (2002::/16), and Teredo (2001::/32), and dead label IL_042f should be removed.
new_findings.observed: IPv6 transition/unspecified/multicast addresses return true from IsPublic(), and dead label IL_042f remains at lines 524-526.
new_findings.remediation: Reject IPAddress.IPv6Any, address.IsIPv6Multicast, and transition prefixes (0x2001/0x0000, 0x2002, 0x0064/0xff9b) in PhotoLoader.IsPublic, and delete lines 524-526.

new_findings.title: Decompiler-Damaged Iterator DemoAgentMomentRows() (Raw Compiler State Machine _003CDemoAgentMomentRows_003Ed__65) and Unbranded 'Relaunch HeyClicky' Action on Developer Settings Page
new_findings.description: In SettingsContent.cs:4252-4260, the iterator method DemoAgentMomentRows() failed ILSpy yield-return decompilation ('//yield-return decompiler failed: Unexpected instruction in Iterator.Dispose()') and directly instantiates a raw compiler-generated state machine class new _003CDemoAgentMomentRows_003Ed__65(-2) { _003C_003E4__this = this }. In addition, immediately above it at line 4247, BuildDeveloperPage() renders SK.ActionRow("Relaunch HeyClicky", "Quits and opens HeyClicky again, e.g. after switching the JIT.", actions.Relaunch, null, null) with hardcoded upstream 'HeyClicky' branding.
new_findings.reproduction:
1. Read src/desktop/Kursor.App/HeyClicky.App.Settings/SettingsContent.cs lines 4240-4265.
2. Observe the raw _003CDemoAgentMomentRows_003Ed__65 state machine instantiation and the 'Relaunch HeyClicky' label.
new_findings.expected: DemoAgentMomentRows() should be reconstructed as a clean C# yield return iterator (eliminating the brittle compiler state machine class), and 'Relaunch HeyClicky' should be rebranded to 'Relaunch Kursor'.
new_findings.observed: Raw _003CDemoAgentMomentRows_003Ed__65 state machine and 'Relaunch HeyClicky' string are compiled into SettingsContent.cs.
new_findings.remediation: Replace _003CDemoAgentMomentRows_003Ed__65 with standard yield return statements in DemoAgentMomentRows() and update line 4247 to 'Relaunch Kursor'.
